exposure: presence of anomaly in another sibling
outcome: parental regret (measured by Decisional Regret Scale)
cohort: Parents of sons younger than 12 years who underwent distal hypospadias repair between January 2016 and December 2019 at the Pediatric Surgery Department, Rawalpindi Medical University, Rawalpindi.
finding: Decisional regret was frequent among parents following hypospadias repair in their sons, with factors related to family dynamics and post-surgical complications significantly associated with higher regret scores.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with increased decisional regret in parents of sons who underwent hypospadias repair.
